title: The occult is behind the cover-up of giants

tellings.quote: I think the occult is behind the cover up of giants.

plain: Tim Alberino, a filmmaker and researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, believes that giants, very large human-like beings, have existed and that their existence is being hidden. He says he thinks the occult, meaning secret mystical groups and practices, is behind that cover-up.
